issue.title: Make sase-github fork-aware across numbered workspaces and PR lifecycle
issue.description: External-contributor research found that sase-github pushes Patch branches to origin, then runs context-sensitive gh pr view/create/merge commands without explicit base/head repository coordinates. Core ensure_git_clone_at clones a primary checkout into numbered workspaces while retaining only origin; a local reproduction confirmed an upstream remote and remote.upstream.gh-resolved=base on the primary disappear in the numbered clone. On a contributor-owned fork this can push correctly to the fork but target PR operations at the fork, and primary-only gh repo set-default configuration does not survive. Scope: detect and persist fork-parent/base/head metadata, make all PR lifecycle operations explicit and fork-aware in every numbered workspace, cover creation/view/close/submit behavior and non-fork regressions, and document the external-contributor topology. Preserve the permission boundary: origin is the contributor fork, upstream code writes must not be required. Full evidence and proposed workaround are in the attached research artifact.
